commits.message:
Add Milkdrop-style WebGPU music visualizer (first clean slice)

Ping-pong feedback pipeline:
  warp pass      — rotate + zoom + decay previous frame (audio-driven)
  waveform pass  — additive triangle-strip ring, time-domain wave displaces outer radius
  present pass   — tone map + vignette to canvas

One hero configuration (no style/palette selectors — tunable via
magic numbers in WGSL, expansion axis for future slices). Audio sources:
demo beat, mic, file. iPad-first: tap-to-start overlay, auto-hiding
chrome, WebGPU-only with graceful error messaging.
